text.what_changes: Bigger candles smooth out the one-day spikes, so their numbers are lower — each has its own alarm line.

text.footer: Scared = TET mood below −0.5 (6 RSIs + 6 'where it closed in its range'). Today's S&P 500 members. Describes, doesn't predict. Not advice.
